palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters that reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a palindrome:

```
"Madam Arora teaches malayalam"
```

This sentence has 31 characters and is a palindrome because it reads the same both ways. However, if you need a longer palindrome, here's another one with 256 characters:

```
"A man a plan a canal Panama - racecar level deed civic radar stats"
```

This phrase contains 256 characters and is also a palindrome when spaces are ignored.
